title: OpenSea Mobile app now live on iOS and Android | OpenSea
summary: The OpenSea mobile app is now live on iOS and Android. Trade tokens and collectibles across 25+ chains, follow top traders, and see your portfolio in one app.
body_markdown:
**Everything you own. Everything you trade. And now, everyone you trade with. All in one app.**


OpenSea Mobile is now live on[iOS](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/opensea-trade-crypto-nfts/id1582861796) and[Android](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=io.opensea&hl=en_US) for everyone. Download the app, sign up with an email, and you're in.


## **What is OpenSea Mobile?**


OpenSea Mobile is the official OpenSea app for iPhone and Android. See your whole portfolio, trade tokens and collectibles across more than 25 blockchains, and follow the people you trade with, all in one app.


It's also[noncustodial](https://opensea.io/learn/what-is-crypto-wallet) , so nobody holds your assets for you. You own them, you control them, and you can take them anywhere. And you don't need any crypto knowledge to get started: no seed phrase, no browser extension, no figuring out which network something lives on. The app handles all of that for you.


## **What can you do with OpenSea Mobile?**


At launch, OpenSea Mobile includes cross-chain trading, one portfolio across every wallet you bring in, a social feed with OpenSea Signals, a referral program, and a single account synced with OpenSea on the web.


### **See everything you own in one portfolio**


Your tokens and collectibles live in one place instead of scattered across apps and spreadsheets. Bring in every wallet you have, and OpenSea Mobile pulls your holdings and history together across all of them.


You can shape the app around what you care about, whether that's tokens first or collectibles first, with prices in USD or crypto. Everything syncs with your account on[opensea.io](https://opensea.io/) , so there's no separate mobile wallet to manage.


### **Trade everything onchain in one slide**


Cross-chain trades happen in a single slide, with no bridging. When you trade, OpenSea searches across multiple onchain venues and aggregators for pricing and liquidity rather than relying on a single source.


Before you buy, token pages show you the full picture: holders and activity aggregated across platforms and chains, updated in real time, including who's talking about a token and who's holding it.


### **See what your network is trading**


The OpenSea Mobile feed is as open as the blockchain itself. Trades from the people you follow reach you as they happen, no matter which app or chain they happened on, and Trending by chain shows what's moving in real time.


### **Share why you bought with OpenSea Signals**


Your trades already show what you did. OpenSea Signals lets you share why. Attach a note to any purchase, whether it's your thinking, your strategy, or what you're seeing, and it travels with the trade to everyone who follows you.


## **How much does it cost to use OpenSea Mobile?**


Downloading OpenSea Mobile and creating an account is free. OpenSea charges a 0.5% fee on token trades and a 1% fee on collectible purchases. Network fees may also apply depending on the chain.


## **How do referrals work on OpenSea Mobile?**


Invite a friend with your referral code and they get 10% off their OpenSea fees. You receive 25% of the fees they generate.[Learn more](https://support.opensea.io/en/articles/15232781-how-do-referrals-work-on-opensea) about how referrals work on OpenSea Mobile.


## **How do I get started with OpenSea Mobile?**


**Step one:** Download the app. Get OpenSea Mobile from the[App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/opensea-trade-crypto-nfts/id1582861796) or[Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=io.opensea&hl=en_US) .


**Step two:** Sign up with your email. The app creates your wallets for you automatically.


**Step three:** Add funds. Use Apple Pay, Google Pay, a debit or credit card, or deposit crypto from another wallet. **‍**


**Step four:** Bring in your existing wallets (optional). Scan a QR code or import a wallet with its private key. Already use OpenSea on the web? Link your web profile during onboarding or anytime in settings. **‍**


**Step five:** Follow people and make your first trade. Follow friends and collectors you want to keep up with, then pick what you want and how you want to pay.


Have questions? The[OpenSea Mobile Help Center](https://support.opensea.io/en/collections/19627377-mobile) has answers.


## **Why does OpenSea Mobile matter?**


In 2018, when OpenSea was just getting started,[we wrote](https://opensea.io/blog/articles/opensea-raises-2-million) that "entire economies will emerge that look very different than even our wildest imaginations." That was a bet. When a wave of people came onchain for the first time in 2020 and 2021, many of them did it using OpenSea. OpenSea Mobile is built to do that again, and now those economies fit in your pocket.


For most people, crypto still ends at buying, holding, and checking a price. OpenSea is built to feel like the culture it carries: vibrant, alive, and fun. It turns crypto from something you check into something you explore.


**Everything you own. Everything you trade. And now, everyone you trade with. See you in OpenSea Mobile!**
